provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Controlled two-spin1/2 isotropic scalar-coupling Hamiltonian with full nonsecular mixing as explicitly supplied. Diagonalize the real symmetric H. For each pair of energy eigenstates i<j, positive frequency=E_j-E_i and transition strength=abs((U_transpose*M*U)_ij)^2. Retain every transition with strength>1e-10 and normalize retained strengths to sum1.
target: Sort lines by increasing frequency; keep aligned strengths. Weak-coupling comparator consists of nu_A +/-J/2 and nu_B +/-J/2. It matches only if every paired sorted line position differs by<=0.1Hz. Eigenvector signs are arbitrary and cannot affect strengths.
scope: These are transition matrix-element strengths, not thermal-population-weighted experimental integrated intensities. No line broadening, real spin assignment or relaxation kinetics is inferred.
